measured_problem: The layer-one direct residual oracle passes at the analytically minimal rank 1044, while the numerically valid fixed-attention linear-plus-route coefficient map fits training coefficients to 0.252314 relative RMSE but generalizes at only 0.506645 coefficient RMSE, 0.981729 output cosine, and 0.153847 output RMSE. Capacity exists, but the fixed post-attention features do not expose coefficients with sufficient held-out generalization.
proposed_architecture: Use a variable residual-rank schedule rather than widening the complete host: keep the passing layer 0 at rank 768, instantiate only layer 1 at the measured rank 1044, copy its existing dual-attention and sparse-feature tensors, initialize its mean, output basis, full-feature coefficient map, and three route maps from the stable V402 analytic solve, then jointly fit every layer-one parameter for exactly one fixed-coverage epoch behind the frozen passing layer-zero prefix.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered variable-rank layer-one joint fit. A pass persists only the two-layer mixed-rank prefix and authorizes an installable host plus physical CPU screen. A miss closes this joint-feature-learning path without rank, initialization, parameter, data, context, objective, optimizer, epoch, route, source, or gate variants.
claim_boundary: Architecture and bounded-fit review only; no installed host, checkpoint, autonomous quality, physical runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
